phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A2 — F2M External Complement Identity Audit
purpose: Test whether the five resident-holder to rest-of-world F2M cells can be derived as unique accounting complements rather than allocated residuals.
hypothesis: For each resident holder, W0 F2M assets equal domestic W2 deposits plus W1 rest-of-world deposits. If the domestic issuer partition is complete and W0/W2/W1 area partition is independently verified, the single missing holder→X value is an exact complement, not a synthetic allocation.
required_gates: H and C issuer columns are structurally NOT_APPLICABLE under ESA 2010
all resident deposit-issuer columns F/G/BNR are observed or exact-derived
holder W0 F2M totals are available on definitionally identical dimensions
total-economy QSA area identity W0 = W2 + W1 passes for stock and flow
sum of the five holder-level complement candidates equals the published total-economy W1 F2M asset control
frequency, instrument, accounting entry, consolidation, unit, currency denominator, valuation, prices and transformation are identical
promotion_rule: Only if every required gate passes may holder→X be classified as an exact DERIVED QSA complement in a later materialization PR.
failure_rule: If any required gate fails or the W1 aggregate is unavailable, the external F2M column remains unresolved and BOP/IIP/BNR external statistics are investigated only as separately reconciled sources.
prohibited: allocating a total external aggregate across holders by shares
using the row residual when more than one issuer cell is unresolved
using BOP/IIP F2 currency-and-deposits as if it were QSA F2M deposits without an explicit instrument bridge
